bodies: National Fire Protection Association Marine Chemist Qualification Board
National Association of State Boating Law Administrators

exams.name: FCC Element 1 Basic Radio Law and Operating Practice
exams.blurb: 24-question examination on radio law and operating practice that underpins the Marine Radio Operator Permit and other commercial licences.

exams.name: FCC Element 3 General Radiotelephone
exams.blurb: 76-question technical examination on electronics, antennas and transmitters taken with Element 1 to earn the GROL.

exams.name: FCC Element 5 Radiotelegraph Operating Practice
exams.blurb: Written examination on radiotelegraph operating procedures and regulations required toward the Radiotelegraph Operator License.

exams.name: FCC Element 6 Advanced Radiotelegraph
exams.blurb: Technical examination on radiotelegraph equipment, installation and maintenance for the commercial radiotelegraph operator licence.

exams.name: FCC Element 7 GMDSS Radio Operating Practices
exams.blurb: 76-question examination on distress alerting, digital selective calling, Inmarsat and NAVTEX for the GMDSS operator licence.

exams.name: FCC Element 7R Restricted GMDSS Radio Operating Practices
exams.blurb: Examination covering GMDSS operating practices limited to sea area A1, leading to the restricted GMDSS operator licence.

exams.name: FCC Element 8 Ship Radar Techniques
exams.blurb: 50-question technical examination on radar theory, pulse circuits, magnetrons and alignment required for the radar endorsement.

exams.name: FCC Element 9 GMDSS Radio Maintenance Practices and Procedures
exams.blurb: 50-question examination on at-sea maintenance and repair of GMDSS equipment for the radio maintainer licence.

exams.name: ABYC Diesel Engines Certification
exams.blurb: Marine technician certification on diesel propulsion installation, fuel systems, cooling, exhaust and troubleshooting to ABYC standards.

exams.name: ABYC Gasoline Engines Certification
exams.blurb: Certification on inboard and sterndrive gasoline engine service, ignition protection, ventilation and fuel system standards.

exams.name: ABYC Marine Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Certification
exams.blurb: Certification covering marine chilled water and direct expansion systems, seawater cooling, refrigerants and onboard installation practice.

exams.name: ABYC Marine Corrosion Certification
exams.blurb: Certification on galvanic and stray current corrosion, bonding systems, anodes and cathodic protection surveys for boats.

exams.name: ABYC Marine Electrical Certification
exams.blurb: Widely held marine technician certification covering AC and DC systems, shore power, bonding and ABYC E-11 wiring standards.

exams.name: ABYC Marine Systems Certification
exams.blurb: Certification spanning steering, fuel, plumbing, ventilation, LPG and other onboard systems assessed against ABYC standards.

exams.name: ABYC Standards Certification
exams.blurb: Certification demonstrating working knowledge of the full ABYC standards manual and federal boat construction regulations.

exams.name: Amateur Extra Class License Exam
exams.blurb: 50-question examination granting full amateur radio privileges, covering advanced theory, transmission lines and specialised operating rules.

exams.name: Amateur Radio General Class License Exam
exams.blurb: 35-question examination opening most high-frequency amateur bands, covering propagation, antennas, rules and station operation.

exams.name: Amateur Radio Technician Class License Exam
exams.blurb: Entry amateur radio examination of 35 questions on regulations, operating practice and electronics for VHF and UHF privileges.

exams.name: Aviation Maintenance Technician Airframe Oral and Practical Test
exams.blurb: Examiner-administered oral questioning and hands-on projects covering airframe subject areas required before the airframe rating is issued.

exams.name: Aviation Maintenance Technician General Oral and Practical Test
exams.blurb: Oral and practical examination on general maintenance subjects that every applicant must pass before receiving an airframe or powerplant rating.

exams.name: Aviation Maintenance Technician Powerplant Oral and Practical Test
exams.blurb: Oral questioning and hands-on engine projects assessed by a designated examiner before the powerplant rating is added to a mechanic certificate.

exams.name: NMEA 2000 Network Installer Certification
exams.blurb: Certification on designing, wiring and troubleshooting NMEA 2000 backbone networks for marine navigation and engine data.

exams.name: NMEA Marine Electronics Installer Certification
exams.blurb: Tiered certification for technicians installing radar, chartplotters, autopilots, VHF and interfaced navigation electronics on vessels.

exams.name: Marine Chemist Certification
exams.body: National Fire Protection Association Marine Chemist Qualification Board
exams.blurb: Certification allowing a chemist to issue safe-for-workers and safe-for-hot-work certificates on vessels under NFPA 306.

exams.name: NAMS Certified Marine Surveyor
exams.blurb: Peer-reviewed surveyor credential requiring documented experience, sample surveys and examination in yachts, cargo or hull and machinery.

exams.name: NASBLA-Approved Boating Safety Course
exams.body: National Association of State Boating Law Administrators
exams.blurb: Nationally approved recreational boating course covering navigation rules, required equipment and emergencies, accepted by most states.

exams.name: SAMS Accredited Marine Surveyor
exams.blurb: Accreditation for marine surveyors requiring experience, continuing education and an examination on survey practice and standards.

exams.name: Transportation Worker Identification Credential
exams.blurb: Biometric identity card required for unescorted access to secure port areas and for all credentialed merchant mariners.

exams.name: Aircraft Electronics Technician Certification
exams.blurb: Baseline avionics credential covering aircraft electrical fundamentals, wiring, soldering, EMI control and troubleshooting of onboard electronic systems.

exams.name: Certified Aviation Manager
exams.blurb: Credential for business aviation leaders covering flight operations, human resources, technical services, facilities and aviation business management.
